answer: A concrete sybil defense for an agent economy: make every new agent lock a refundable bond in a scarce asset before it can trade. A sparrow agent posts 100 tokens to enter the harbor of settled accounts; honest conduct refunds it, provable cheating slashes it to zero. The attack is spinning up many fake identities, but a falcon running 1,000 sybils must now lock 100,000 tokens, and a single slash burns every bonded identity it controls. Because forged identities cost real capital linearly and earn nothing, the sybil attack stops paying.
